title: Defensive copies in readonly members
prompt: A mutable struct stored in a readonly field is copied on every member access. Implement struct `Container` with `private readonly Mut _m;` and a `public int Get()` that reads `_m.Value` twice and returns their sum. Implement struct `Mut { public int Value; }`. The lesson: each `_m.Value` read copies first — implement it so the TEST (which checks the sum) passes; you cannot observe the copies from outside, which is exactly the point: they are invisible but real.

tests.name: sum
tests.code:
var c = new Container();
Cj.Eq(c.Get(), 0, "default Mut.Value is 0, sum 0+0");
